The HTML pages of the party's websites change on every request (two downloads of one page a few seconds apart differed), so the page is not a reproducible identity and the JSON record is recorded instead. This packet downloaded it at 11:48:40Z and 12:28:46Z on 1 October 2026, the first and last 40 minutes apart (at least 30 minutes apart), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256, using curl with its default User-Agent, without --compressed and with no Accept-Encoding request header; the body was served with no Content-Encoding, so the identity is the uncompressed body. This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
